dataset.description: The dataset consists of R package scripts, documentation, test files, and sample data used in the development and application of the OtsuFire framework. This package enables burned area mapping from Landsat data using stratified Otsu-based thresholding. Input data formats include GeoTIFF rasters (.tif), shapefiles (.shp), and tabular files (.csv). Scripts are in R (.R), and metadata is provided in Markdown and PDF formats. The code and sample datasets allow full reproducibility and testing of fire detection workflows, with special focus on Mediterranean ecosystems.This research is part of the project INFORICAM (PID2020-119402RB- I00), funded by the Agencia Estatal de Investigación MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033 and by the European Union.
